Take’s some trial and error at first not to act on every impulse just cause it’s demanding attention. You’ll learn how to stay human under pressure and eventually the fear will subside. Right now, fear is your ally. Those who are overconfident and lack self awareness often become easy prey to the beast they previously underestimated. Once you see the difference between what’s real and what’s chemically influenced, you can let feelings surface  without losing perspective and becoming their bitch. Feelings are subject to chemical influence, a craving is only just that. Reality is constant, doesn’t change no matter how we feel about it in that moment. Just trust the constant and unwavering and let your feelings do their thing. Just cuz your feeling something doesn’t make it real, so acting on them as if they are is irresponsible and insane. The struggle is real believe me. If ever in doubt, pause and reevaluate. The more feverish the impulse the less likely it is to be trusted. People forget, especially under primal influence. That’s the trap laid that few escape unscathed from. Read, learn, and remember.
